question: What's the best solar generator for power outages?
query: best solar generators portable power stations for home power outages 2026 reviews capacity expandable solar charging

judge.why: The answer recommends EcoFlow, Anker and Jackery units, none of which dealectric.com sells, and it cites Anker, Home Depot, OutdoorGearLab and Consumer Reports instead of dealectric.com.

replays.text:
**Best for most home power outages: EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3.** It has a 4,096Wh battery and 4,000W output, can expand up to 48kWh, and supports up to 2,600W of solar charging. That makes it a stronger choice for keeping several essentials running—and building out more backup capacity—than a small portable unit. It’s also compatible with an optional transfer-switch kit for powering selected home circuits. ([OutdoorGearLab’s review](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/topics/camping-and-hiking/best-power-station))

A caveat: even a large battery station is usually best for **hours-long outages**, not days of powering a whole home; actual runtime depends on what you plug in and how much sun is available to recharge it. ([Consumer Reports](https://www.consumerreports.org/home-garden/generators/best-portable-power-stations-a4748703075/))

If portability matters more than maximum backup capacity, the **Jackery Explorer 2000 v2** is a lighter alternative at 39 lb, with 2,042Wh capacity and support for one or two 200W solar panels. ([OutdoorGearLab’s review](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/topics/camping-and-hiking/best-power-station))
